courses.title: Critical Reading in Immunobiology
courses.description: Literature review of cellular, molecular, genetic and biochemical analysis of in vitro and in vivo immunology. VIRIM 580 Critical Readings in Immunology (1) A critical discussion of primary literature in molecular and cellular immunology to be presented and discussed by students to students participating in this course and faculty of the virology and immunology option of the biomedical and medical sciences (BMS) program. The goals of this seminar format course are twofold. First, students will develop skills in presenting scientific literature to a critical audience of their peers. Second, students will review in depth and critically evaluate current literature in immunobiology, as presented in high impact peer reviewed scientific publications.
